column1: # Lines on which bash 3.2, 5.2 and 5.3 all run `canary` (a recording stub), read by the permission gate
# with `canary` denied and `git status` allowed. `deny`: the gate denies the line.
# `not_allow`: the gate leaves the line to the host, as it does a quoted script or a substitution it
# cannot say how the shell reads. Never an allow. Fields: expectation, line (`\\` `\n` `\t` escaped).
# The name only labels a failure.

column3: echo $(case x in (x) canary;; esac); git status
git status | cat | head -30\ncanary && cd s
if git status; then canary; fi
for i in 1; do canary; done
